scripts.text:
[Freidrich]
^3355FFJuno^000000 is kept aloft in the air by an ancient and mysterious force.
scripts.translation:
[弗莱德里希]
^3355FF朱诺^000000依靠一股古老而神秘的力量悬浮在空中。

scripts.text:
[Freidrich]
This power is said to come from a relic from an ancient civilization called ^3355FFJuperos^000000 which existed here long before Juno.
scripts.translation:
[弗莱德里希]
据说这股力量源自一个名为^3355FF朱佩洛斯^000000的古代文明遗迹，它早在朱诺之前就已存在于此。

scripts.text:
[Freidrich]
Research revealed that Juno's power source based on ^3355FFPieces of Ymir's Heart^000000. I hear that this power source is found where Juperos used to exist.
scripts.translation:
[弗莱德里希]
研究表明，朱诺的动力源基于^3355FF尤米尔之心碎片^000000。我听说这种动力源就存在于朱佩洛斯曾经所在的地方。

scripts.text:
[Freidrich]
Since many scholars have been coming to Juno to study and research this power source, our city is basically a well known mecca for scholars.
scripts.translation:
[弗莱德里希]
由于许多学者来到朱诺研究这种动力源，我们的城市基本上已成为学者们众所周知的圣地。

scripts.text:
[Freidrich]
The city of Sages,
^3355FFJuno,^000000 is made of
three islands.
scripts.translation:
[弗莱德里希]
贤者之城
^3355FF朱诺^000000由
三座岛屿组成。

scripts.text:
[Freidrich]
These are Solomon, the island of honor, Mineta, the island of prosperity, and Snotora, the island of knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[弗莱德里希]
它们分别是代表荣誉的所罗门、代表繁荣的米内塔，以及代表知识的斯诺托拉。

scripts.text:
[Freidrich]
The location of each island is
North-west : Solomon
North-east : Snotora
South : Mineta.
scripts.translation:
[弗莱德里希]
各岛屿的位置如下：
西北：所罗门
东北：斯诺托拉
南方：米内塔。

scripts.text:
[Granny]
So, do you enjoy candy?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
那么，你喜欢糖果吗？

scripts.text:
[Granny]
*Giggle giggle*
The time has come.
Well then...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
*咯咯咯*
时候到了。
那么...

scripts.text:
[Granny]
I am an old Sage granny who foresees everything...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
我是一位能预见一切的老年贤者奶奶...

scripts.text: ^3355FFGranny hands you some candy^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF老奶奶递给你一些糖果^000000。

scripts.text:
[Granny]
You've already chosen. It doesn't matter whether or not you get this candy. That doesn't matter at all. You have to understand why it's happened.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你已经做出了选择。无论你是否接受这颗糖果都无关紧要。重要的是，你必须明白为什么会发生这样的事。

scripts.text:
[Granny]
Here's ^3355FF1,000 zeny^000000.
Do you accept this?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
这是^3355FF1,000 Zeny^000000。
你接受吗？

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Do not accept
scripts.translation: 不接受

scripts.text:
[Granny]
*Giggle*
There you go~
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
*咯咯*
给你~

scripts.text:
[Granny]
*Giggle*
Well then...
See you ~
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
*咯咯*
那么...
再见~

scripts.text:
[Granny]
Yes, that's right. Now you must ask yourself why you didn't accept the candy I offered.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
是的，没错。现在你必须问问自己，为什么没有接受我提供的糖果。

scripts.text:
[Granny]
Have you heard of a boss monster that has been around Juno for a long time? It's known only as the ^FF3355Lord of the Dead^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你听说过一只在朱诺徘徊已久的首领魔物吗？它只被称为^FF3355死灵骑士^000000。

scripts.text:
[Granny]
It is rumored to be from the realm of the dead. It brings many undead monsters with it, intending to lead living creatures to its cold and icy realm.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
传说它来自亡灵界。它带着许多不死魔物，意图将生者引向它冰冷寒冷的领域。

scripts.text:
[Granny]
You have already chosen whether or not you will challenge the Lord of the Dead. All you need to do right now is understand why you made the decision.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你已经做出了是否挑战死灵骑士的决定。现在，你只需要弄清楚自己为何做出这个决定。

scripts.text:
[Sergiof]
My name is Sergiof,
the fighter who
serves Granny.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔吉奥夫]
我是谢尔吉奥夫，
侍奉老奶奶的格斗家。

scripts.text:
[Sergiof]
I will tell you about ^3355FFGrand Peco^000000 which is a high level Peco Peco. Grand Peco is faster than Peco Peco and is quite aggressive.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔吉奥夫]
我来告诉你关于^3355FF七彩大嘴鸟^000000的事，它是一种高级的大嘴鸟。七彩大嘴鸟比大嘴鸟更快，而且极具攻击性。

scripts.text:
[Sergiof]
It attacks using its strong bill and many Peco Pecos follow it. There's quite a difference in power between Peco Peco and the Grand Peco.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔吉奥夫]
它用强壮的喙进行攻击，许多大嘴鸟会跟随它。大嘴鸟和七彩大嘴鸟之间的实力差距相当大。

scripts.text:
[Ninno]
You are very lucky to have me tell you this story. This only happens by ^FF33551 out of a 1,000 chance^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼诺]
你能听到这个故事，真是幸运。这只有^FF3355千分之一的几率^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ninno]
Have you ever heard of an Egyptian king who was once believed to be a son of a god? His name is ^3355FFPharoah^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼诺]
你听说过一位埃及国王吗？他曾被认为是一位神的儿子。他的名字是^3355FF法老^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ninno]
This world you are experiencing is actually fabricated! It's time for you to see reality for what it is!
scripts.translation:
[尼诺]
你所经历的这个世界其实是虚构的！是时候让你看清现实的真面目了！

scripts.text:
[Ninno]
Open your eyes! Stop being manipulated by virtual reality!
scripts.translation:
[尼诺]
睁开你的眼睛！不要再被虚拟现实所操控了！

scripts.text:
[Ninno]
He was rumored to be a high sorcerer that used his power to curse innocents. It is said that he is still around, placing his curses on people.
scripts.translation:
[尼诺]
传说他是一位强大的妖术师，利用自己的力量诅咒无辜者。据说他至今仍在四处游荡，对人们施加诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Ninno]
As an adventurer, it's possible that you may see him in your travels. Be careful...
scripts.translation:
[尼诺]
作为一名冒险者，你在旅途中可能会遇到他。小心...

scripts.text:
[Le Morpheus]
Look in my hand. I am holding two different kinds of herbs.
scripts.translation:
[勒·墨菲斯]
看看我的手中。我拿着两种不同的药草。

scripts.text:
[Le Morpheus]
Hmm. I'm sorry to say you just missed a fortunate chance. However, I can tell you don't have enough wealth to bring this fortune to fruition.
scripts.translation:
[勒·墨菲斯]
嗯。很遗憾，你刚刚错过了一个幸运的机会。不过，我可以看出你并没有足够的财富来实现这份幸运。

scripts.text:
[Le Morpheus]
^3355FFApocalypse^000000...
It is the name of an android that used to guard Juno long ago.
scripts.translation:
[勒·墨菲斯]
^3355FF阿修罗机械战士^000000...
这是很久以前守护朱诺的一个机器人的名字。

scripts.text:
[Le Morpheus]
One is a ^3355FFBlue Herb^000000 which will make you forget about reality and keep you in this virtual reality^000000.
scripts.translation:
[勒·墨菲斯]
其中一种是^3355FF蓝色药草^000000，它会让你忘记现实，并让你留在这个虚拟现实中^000000。

scripts.text:
[Le Morpheus]
The other is a ^FF3355Red Herb^000000 which will reveal to you what is true and real.
scripts.translation:
[勒·墨菲斯]
另一种是^FF3355红色药草^000000，它会向你揭示什么是真实和现实的。

scripts.text:
[Le Morpheus]
Whichever one you choose, you must spend ^3355FF5,000 zeny^000000. Now, please select one.
scripts.translation:
[勒·墨菲斯]
无论你选择哪一种，都必须花费^3355FF5,000 Zeny^000000。现在，请做出选择。

scripts.text: Choose ^FF3355Red Herb^000000
scripts.translation: 选择^FF3355红色药草^000000

scripts.text: Choose ^3355FFBlue Herb^000000.
scripts.translation: 选择^3355FF蓝色药草^000000

scripts.text:
[Le Morpheus]
As you have chosen, you will forget everything, and remain in this virtual reality.
scripts.translation:
[勒·墨菲斯]
既然你做出了选择，你将忘记一切，并留在这个虚拟现实中。

scripts.text:
[Le Morpheus]
You will see the truth.
scripts.translation:
[勒·墨菲斯]
你将看到真相。

scripts.text:
[Le Morpheus]
Because its artificial intelligence has corrupted over the years, it can no longer distinguish comrades from enemies. Sadly, that android is nothing but a mindless monster now.
scripts.translation:
[勒·墨菲斯]
由于人工智能在岁月中逐渐腐化，它已无法分辨敌友。可悲的是，那个机器人如今不过是一具没有思想的魔物罢了。

scripts.text:
[Artisan]
*Mumble mumble...*
scripts.translation:
[工匠]
*咕哝咕哝...*

scripts.text:
[Artisan]
Oh, hello there. Let me introduce myself. I am an artisan who tries to succeed the rights and duties of item makers in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[工匠]
哦，你好。让我自我介绍一下。我是一名工匠，致力于继承朱诺物品制造者的权利与职责。

scripts.text: About Powerful Equipment
scripts.translation: 关于强力装备

scripts.text: About Unique Items
scripts.translation: 关于独特物品

scripts.text: About Authentic Food
scripts.translation: 关于正宗美食

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Artisan]
Let me suggest the ^3355FFHoly Guard^000000 and ^3355FFHoly Avenger^000000 which are special items for Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[工匠]
我推荐^3355FF圣耀之盾^000000和^3355FF神圣复仇者之剑^000000，它们是十字军的特殊物品。

scripts.text:
[Artisan]
These pieces of equipment are very light and have sufficient abilities. They also happen to possess holy power.
scripts.translation:
[工匠]
这些装备非常轻便，且拥有充足的能力。它们还恰好蕴含着神圣之力。

scripts.text:
[Artisan]
Therefore, this equipment is more powerful over some kinds of monsters such as Ghosts or the Undead.
scripts.translation:
[工匠]
因此，这套装备对幽灵或亡灵等特定类型的魔物更为强力。

scripts.text:
[Artisan]
However it is rumored that only a few chosen Crusaders are able to obtain those items due of their rarity.
scripts.translation:
[工匠]
不过据说，由于这些物品极为稀有，只有少数被选中的十字军才能获得它们。

scripts.text:
[Artisan]
It looks like a simple scroll marked with concentric circles and a star. Although the ^FF3355Worn-Out Magic Scroll^000000 is very old, it's wanted by many Sages for research purposes.
scripts.translation:
[工匠]
它看起来像是一张标有同心圆和星星的简单卷轴。虽然^FF3355老旧魔法图^000000非常古老，但许多贤者为了研究目的而渴望得到它。

scripts.text:
[Artisan]
It seems you can use that item when you chant a high-level magic spell.
scripts.translation:
[工匠]
似乎当你吟唱高级魔法咒语时，可以使用该物品。

scripts.text:
[Artisan]
^3355FFRice Cake^000000! Yes, it's a traditional food that's favored by a lot of people. There's a lot of nostalgic memories of old fashioned markets that are connected to the Rice Cake.
scripts.translation:
[工匠]
^3355FFQ弹的长条糕^000000！是的，这是一种深受许多人喜爱的传统食物。许多关于旧式市场的怀旧记忆都与Q弹的长条糕联系在一起。

scripts.text:
[Artisan]
Ahhh~
I wish I could eat a bit of Rice Cake right now.
scripts.translation:
[工匠]
啊哈~
我现在真想吃一点Q弹的长条糕。

scripts.text:
[Artisan]
Although Juno is known as a city of Sages, I hope you understand that ordinary people live and prosper here as well. Please enjoy the unique atmosphere that Juno has to offer.
scripts.translation:
[工匠]
虽然朱诺以贤者之城闻名，但我希望您能理解，普通百姓也在这里生活并繁荣发展。请尽情享用朱诺所独有的氛围。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
欢迎来到崇尚高尚品德的城市——朱诺。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
There is a monster near here known as Lava Golem. This golem is made from a stone heart whose power happened to be amplified with magic power when it was swept away by molten rock.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
附近有一种被称为熔岩巨石的魔物。这个巨石怪是由一颗石心构成的，当它被熔岩冲刷时，其力量恰好被魔力放大。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
The lava dripping from its body is so hot that it can melt down armor and weapons made out of high quality steel.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
从它身上滴落的熔岩温度极高，足以熔化由优质钢材制成的盔甲和武器。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
You'd better be careful when you encounter this monster. It will damage armor and weapons in the twinkling of an eye.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
遇到这种魔物时你最好小心。它会在眨眼间损坏你的盔甲和武器。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
欢迎来到崇尚高尚品德的城市——朱诺。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Geographer...
That monster looks like a flower blooming from the ground.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
邪恶向日葵...
那种魔物看起来像是一朵从地面绽放的花朵。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Strangely, it can extend its body a long distance. Even if you're far away from it, it can still pose a threat.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
奇怪的是，它能将身体延伸得很远。即使你离它很远，它依然能构成威胁。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
The name of this monster originated from a story about a poor geographer who, unfortunately, was eaten by this monster while he was immersed in his studies.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
这种魔物的名字源于一个故事：一位贫穷的邪恶向日葵学者，不幸在专心研究时被这种魔物吃掉了。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
欢迎来到崇尚高尚品德的城市——朱诺。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Near Juno, there exists a fallen angel named 'False Angel.' It feigns innocence, pretending to bless adventurers and then stabbing them in the back without any warning.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
在朱诺附近，存在一种名为“伪天使”的堕天使。它伪装成无辜的样子，假装祝福冒险者，然后毫无预警地从背后偷袭。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Don't be fooled by its appearance, or you'll find yourself in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
不要被它的外表所欺骗，否则你会陷入麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
欢迎来到崇尚高尚品德的城市——朱诺。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
'Goat' is a monster that was an antelope living in the high mountains that was somehow turned into a monster.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
“山羊”是一种魔物，原本是生活在高山上的羚羊，不知为何变成了魔物。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Even if you manage to dodge to its horns, you still need to be wary of its powerful legs.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
即使你成功躲开了它的角，仍需警惕它强有力的腿。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Goat's legs are so strong because it's always climbing cliffs when it's not busy slaughtering the innocent.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
山羊的腿非常强壮，因为除了屠杀无辜者之外，它总是在攀爬悬崖。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
欢迎来到崇尚高尚品德的城市——朱诺。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Have you ever
seen a Large Jellopy?
Those things are huuuge!
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
你见过巨大杰勒比结晶吗？
那些东西好大好大！

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
It's hard to believe
that such a large and
shining jellopy even exists!
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
很难相信竟然存在如此巨大且闪耀的杰勒比结晶！

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
欢迎来到崇尚高尚品德的城市——朱诺。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Among the Sage's weapons, there is a 'Dagger of Counter.'
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
在贤者的武器中，有一把名为“反击短剑”的武器。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Its use is limited to the Sage class, and it increases the chance of inflicting critical attacks. So, for Sages, that dagger can be very useful, as well as make them look stylish in battle.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
它的使用仅限于贤者职业，并能增加发动暴击攻击的几率。因此，对于贤者来说，这把短剑非常有用，也能让他们在战斗中看起来更帅气。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
欢迎来到崇尚高尚品德的城市——朱诺。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
There is a holy shield named 'Sacred Mission' which can only be used by Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
有一面名为“大天使之盾”的神圣之盾，只有十字军才能使用。

scripts.text:
[Juno Soldier]
It's a long and narrow shield with an angel wing engraved in the center of the front side. Against Devil and Undead monsters, it is especially powerful.
scripts.translation:
[朱诺士兵]
这是一面细长形的盾牌，正面中央雕刻着天使发圈。对抗恶魔和亡灵魔物时，它特别强大。

scripts.text:
[Airship Representative]
Good day, I am here to inform you
about the Juno Airship which
we plan to operate in the near future.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇代表]
您好，我在此向您通报关于朱诺飞空艇的情况，我们计划在近期开始运营。

scripts.text:
[Air ship Representative]
Unfortunately, it is still in
development, and we've yet
to complete testing. However,
we feel the need to let our
eager customers know of our
progress.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇代表]
不幸的是，它仍在开发中，我们尚未完成测试。然而，我们需要让热切的顾客了解我们的进展。

scripts.text:
[Airship Representative]
The Airship we're developing will provide you with convenient travel to any town. You can also enjoy the sights while aloft in the sky. Unique products from various areas will also be provided.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇代表]
我们正在开发的飞空艇将为您提供前往任何城镇的便捷旅行。您还可以在空中欣赏风景。此外，还将提供来自各个地区的特色产品。

scripts.text:
[Airship Representative]
We promise our customers an
amazing travel experience
once the Airship is in
operation. In the meantime,
we are providing a special
teleport service.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇代表]
我们承诺，一旦飞空艇开始运营，将为顾客提供绝佳的旅行体验。在此期间，我们提供特殊的瞬间移动服务。

scripts.text:
[Airship Representative]
The teleport fee is 1,800 zeny, regardless of where you want to go. Please let me know your desired destination.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇代表]
无论您想去哪里，瞬间移动费用均为1,800 Zeny。请告诉我您想去的目的地。

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Izlude
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得岛

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬
